verdict.rationale: Granola's docs show that Granola Chat answers natural-language questions about your meetings, and that it can query all of your meetings from the home screen, a single meeting, or a folder. That covers the cross-history Q&A core. The docs never say Chat answers cite their source meetings or transcript passages. The magnifying-glass source trace belongs to AI-enhanced notes, a separate feature, so it doesn't count here. Missing for 10: documented source citations in Chat answers, independent or hands-on corroboration of cross-history answer quality.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Granola Chat lets you ask questions about your meetings and get instant insights from your notes or transcripts.
You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
Chat with your meeting notes to recall meeting details, spot patterns across customer calls
